verses.english: Focus, the Exterior, and the End of Relishing

verses.pali: “Rūpe, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, rūpāniccatañca yathābhūtaṁ samanupassatha.
verses.english: “Mendicants, rationally apply the mind to sights. Truly see the impermanence of sights.

verses.pali: Rūpe, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, rūpāniccatañca yathābhūtaṁ samanupassanto rūpesupi nibbindati.
verses.english: When a mendicant does this, they grow disillusioned with sights.
When relishing ends, greed ends. When greed ends, relishing ends.
When relishing and greed end, the mind is said to be well freed.
Rationally apply the mind to sounds …

verses.pali: dhamme, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, dhammāniccatañca yathābhūtaṁ samanupassatha.
verses.english: ideas. Truly see the impermanence of ideas.

verses.pali: Dhamme, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasikaronto, dhammāniccatañca yathābhūtaṁ samanupassanto dhammesupi nibbindati.
verses.english: When a mendicant does this, they grow disillusioned with ideas.
When relishing and greed end, the mind is said to be well freed.”
